  • Method Details

    • destroy

      boolean destroy(Object r)
      Destroys the supplied contextual reference if and only if it meets the conditions for destruction.
      Parameters:
      r - a contextual reference; may be null in which case false will be returned
      Returns:
      true if and only if destruction occurred
      Throws:
      DestructionException - if an error occurs

    • references

      <R> References<R> references(AttributedType t)
      Returns a References capable of locating contextual references of the relevant type.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the contextual reference type
      Parameters:
      t - an AttributedType describing the contextual reference type; must not be null
      Returns:
      a non-null References
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if t is null
      See Also:
      • References

    • reference

      default <R> R reference(AttributedType t)
      A convenience method that acquires and returns what is presumed, possibly incorrectly, to be the sole contextual reference of the relevant type.
      Type Parameters:
      R - the contextual reference type
      Parameters:
      t - an AttributedType describing the contextual reference type; must not be null
      Returns:
      a non-null contextual reference
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if t is null
      UnsatisfiedReductionException - if there is no contextual reference for the relevant type
      AmbiguousReductionException - if there is more than one contextual reference for the relevant type
      See Also:
      • references(AttributedType)
